name: ultrapowers
description: Tackle large tasks as a series of one-session 'slices': brainstorm a high-level overview, then implement -> handoff -> complete in fresh sessions so output quality never degrades. Slices may fan out parallel subagents for independent chunks. Run it autonomously with /autopilot (refreshing its own context after every slice until the task is done, optionally with per-slice review gates), or sketch ideas mid-brainstorm with /visualize. Tasks blocked on human-only steps finish with a short 'Your turn' checklist instead of stalling. Small tasks are built inline.
